title: Bug Hunt mismatched form state
expectedPositive: Type, reset and programmatically update the field; preview and submitted payload must be consistent, with no independent useState shadow.
expectedNegative: Separate useState preview and RHF input values drift after reset or programmatic update.
securityBoundary: Treat displayed form previews as user content; React text interpolation escapes text, while innerHTML would introduce an XSS risk.
